item.title: ‘She killed the kids!’ 911 call from Lindsay Clancy’s husband brings tears to the courtroom
item.description: A Massachusetts mother who strangled her three young children and tried to kill herself sobbed in court as jurors listened to her then-husband’s anguished 911 call from that day.
